name: Yomoda Sakae
source:
The cool and calm crossing dressing teacher.
He is one of the people in charge of the "cross dressers pregnancy project" and also a candidate. He aims to figure out how a cross dresser can be impregnated but so far hasn't succeed.

He is a researcher before a teacher so he cross dresses of his own accord in order to observe the pregnancy process. He has refined his sexual technique to improve the efficiency of his research so many students have become captivated by his technique.

Claims to be born from a male and trap parent.
